title: Mahmoud Darwish and Tamar Ben Ami: The impossible love of a Palestinian poet and an Israeli dancer
subhed: In the early 1960s, in Haifa, Israel, the young Palestinian poet Mahmoud Darwish fell in love with Tamar Ben Ami, a Jewish Israeli dancer. Their romance was intense but brief. From this forbidden love, the writer composed a poignant poem, 'Rita and the Rifle,' which is still sung throughout the Arab world.

French court shuts down establishment hosting paid gang bangs in Paris
subhed: France's highest administrative court upheld the temporary closure of a venue that hosted these sexual activities in mid-July while awaiting a final ruling. The court found that the events at the establishment exposed women to 'serious risks' to their physical and psychological well-being, but it did not ban the practices themselves.

title: Alain Robert, the 'French Spiderman': 'Falling is not an option'
subhed: In an interview with Le Monde, climber Alain Robert reflects on the sensation that drives him to risk his life by scaling the world's tallest skyscrapers without any ropes.

title: Adolf and Rudolf Dassler, the Cain and Abel of sports shoes
subhed: 'Sewn and torn' (6/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. United by their passion for sports, the two German brothers grew their shoe factory for more than a decade. Separated by WWII, each went on to create his own brand, Adidas and Puma, through which their fierce rivalry was played out.

title: 'The End of Oak Street': Jurassic Park comes to suburban America
subhed: Blending prehistoric science fiction with a satire of American suburbia, David Robert Mitchell playfully subverts the conventions of Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, delivering a B-movie that is both wild and cleverly twisted.

subhed: According to a working document seen by Le Monde, UEFA, CONCACAF and the AFC want to change FIFA's presidency into a rotating, representative and ceremonial role with a 'fixed two-year term,' modeled on the Swiss Confederation.

title: Environmental amnesia: How we can't even remember the lost biodiversity of yore
subhed: While we can recall car windshields covered with dead insects after a drive, what do we know about wolves that once roamed the countryside in the Middle Ages, or salmon swimming in the Seine in the 19th century? This gradual forgetting of what was once a teeming natural world prevents us from protecting today's nature.

title: The eternal Rome of Maria Grazia Chiuri, creative director of Fendi
